remarks: Beautiful, updated 2-bedroom, 2-full bath apartment close to Downtown Stamford! Located in the desirable Chesterfield Complex, this spacious apartment offers 9ft ceilings, quartz countertops and newly updated lighting. The open layout of the kitchen and living room is ideal for hosting, and brings light throughout the entire living space! The kitchen has a closet pantry, updated appliances and a new reverse osmosis water system. The primary bedroom has a full bathroom, attached balcony and walk-in closet. This gorgeous unit is ready for it's new owner!   Storage unit within the building included. Covered, attached parking and plenty of visitor parking available. The complex has 2 pools available to owner/occupant. Located within walking distance of the Ridgeway Shopping Center and easy access to 95 and the Metro North.
